name: Sihon
bio: Sihon was the king of the Amorites, ruling from his capital Heshbon, who had earlier seized territory from the king of Moab. When Israel asked to pass through his land, Sihon instead mobilized his whole army to fight them at Jahaz; Israel struck him down and took all his territory from the Arnon to the Jabbok, settling in Heshbon and its surrounding towns (Numbers 21:21-26). Sihon's defeat is recalled repeatedly in Deuteronomy and Joshua as a lasting example of how the LORD gave Israel victory over its enemies.
